prompts.biome:
Create a production game sprite kit sheet, landscape 1536x1024, 4 columns x 3 rows of equal cells, twelve DISTINCT isolated hand-painted isometric environment modules, transparent background. No lettering, no grid lines. Strict orthographic isometric view matching classic detailed dark fantasy RPG, ground axes 2 horizontal to 1 vertical. Grounded burning hell biome: weathered dark gray basalt, fine warm gray ash, tiny restrained ember fissures, painterly photoreal texture, light from upper left. This is natural landscape, absolutely NO masonry walls, no architecture, no skulls, no skeletons. Natural low broad irregular slopes and rock formations that blend into ash terrain. Each module has generous transparent margins, is wholly inside its own cell and does NOT touch any other module. Occupy middle 80% width of cell, base around 78% cell height, max height 65% cell. All twelve share consistent scale and light.
Row 1: (1) long low basalt/ash bank going screen upper-left to lower-right; (2) matching bank going upper-right to lower-left; (3) alternate first direction with a fractured rock cluster; (4) alternate second direction with a fractured rock cluster.
Row 2: (1) convex 90 degree isometric bank corner, two wings meeting at center; (2) concave 90 degree isometric bank corner; (3) tapered end of first-direction bank; (4) tapered end of second-direction bank.
Row 3: (1) broken first-direction bank with tiny ember crevice; (2) broken second-direction bank; (3) flat isometric diamond of feather-edged ash scree and scattered pebbles, NO upright object; (4) compact irregular basalt outcrop with feather-edged ash foot.
Design straight modules as a seamless natural bank course three world tiles long. Silhouette rough and organic, base broad and soft. True transparency outside painted sprites. No background scenery, no horizon, no cast shadows extending outside cell.
prompts.defense:
Production sprite sheet for a detailed hand-painted isometric dark fantasy RPG. Square 1536x1536, precise 4 columns x 4 rows equal cells. Sixteen distinct isolated modules on TRUE TRANSPARENT background, no labels or grid lines. NO gray backdrop or contact shadows filling the sheet. Orthographic isometric, ground axes 2 horizontal to 1 vertical, light upper left, matching all cells. Grounded Hell redoubt DEFENSIVE kit: battered dark basalt masonry, restrained iron bands, occasional weathered rust-red cloth, low crenellations, ash/dust at base. No skulls, skeletons, characters or bright magic. Modules three world tiles long, wall height approximately one-half its projected horizontal span, thick continuous cap. Generous empty margins in every cell. Each full object inside its cell, base center around 78 percent cell height, consistent scale. Wall modules span middle 76 percent cell width. Doorway interior fully TRANSPARENT, NO painted view, no floor behind, opening tall and generous for a walking hero.
Row 1: east axis straight wall (screen upper-left to lower-right); south axis matching wall (upper-right to lower-left); alternate east straight with weathered iron; alternate south straight.
Row 2: outer convex L corner with wings exactly matching straight wall cross-section; inner concave L corner; east wall finished end cap; south wall finished end cap.
Row 3: east damaged but continuous wall; south damaged but continuous wall; east doorway connecting wall/jamb module; south doorway connecting wall/jamb module.
Row 4: front of simple battle-worn camp gatehouse with open arch, modest side piers attached to short wall shoulders, diagonal east-axis opening; reverse side matching camp gatehouse also with open arch and diagonal east-axis opening; flat feather-edged isometric ash-and-stone paving diamond; compact square buttress/post matching wall thickness.
Every cell a separate complete sprite, consistent hand-painted realistic stone detail. Warm but muted overall, small restrained embers only. True alpha background.
